title: Chargers put WR KeAndre Lambert-Smith on IR

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Chargers put WR KeAndre Lambert-Smith on IR
sources.description: Wide receiver KeAndre Lambert-Smith injured his hamstring in Sunday's loss to the Cardinals and he's going to be out of action for at least the next month as a result.
